name: AI Image Filename
description: Renames uploaded images using ai vision (descriptive filenames for seo/accessibility).
project_description:
Automatically renames uploaded images using AI vision to generate descriptive, SEO-friendly filenames based on image content.

 Back to top 

 Overview 
 When an image is uploaded to Drupal, this module will send the image to an AI Vision Model, and rename the file with a short, descriptive filename. For example: golden-retriever-catching-frisbee-in-park.jpg . Rather than having a bunch of non-descriptive images, like IMG_1234.jpg , you can finally have clean image filenames.

 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 
 Drupal 10 or 11 
 AI module with a configured provider that supports Chat with Image Vision 
 
 Back to top 

 Installation 
 Install as you would normally install a contributed Drupal module. For further

information, see

 Installing Drupal Modules .

 Back to top 

 Configuration 
 
 Navigate to Administration > Configuration > AI > AI Image Filename at /admin/config/ai/ai-image-filename 
 Configure the settings as such... 
 
 
 
 
 Setting 
 Description 
 
 
 
 
 Enable 
 Toggle AI filename generation on or off without uninstalling the module. 
 
 
 AI Prompt 
 The prompt sent to the AI Chat with Vision model that will be used to generate the filename. 
 
 
 AI Provider/Model 
 The specific vision-capable model used to understand the context of the image.
